review_reference: Owner decision in chat by D-Eminence, 2026-11-02/03 (coordination notes, owner-decisions.md, Migrate item 7): "allowance 500 pages/facility/month (Textract+AI), only super admin raises, 100% pauses reading but not review/manual entry" (0110, Session B, Migrate AI reading); unsigned until the owner signs
evidence: 0110 (OCR page allowance), unsigned until the owner signs (reviewed_by is empty). Written on 0103; in the release it follows 0104-0109 but uses none of their objects and its preconditions ask for none of them. Backward compatible: two new tables and six new functions in schema ocr, one more allowed transition in the existing trigger function ocr.validate_job_write (CREATE OR REPLACE; signature, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path, volatility, owner and ACL kept; md5 e9ea263ec9f29355eb9a6a81fd2d7b37 before, 3845db7ce3552ff6ab680098373cdd71 after), no other table, column, constraint, policy, trigger or function change, no row touched. Today's ocr-api, ocr-worker and identity-api images run unchanged. WHAT IT DOES. ocr.facility_page_limits (facility_id pk -> identity.facilities, pages_limit 1-100000, set_by_account_id, reason 1-240, set_at) and ocr.page_usage (job_id pk, no foreign key to ocr.jobs so the count outlives 24-hour working data; facility_id -> identity.facilities; usage_month = first day of the Africa/Lagos month of the first recording; pages 1-200; recorded_at): row-level security forced, one policy for the OCR functions' owner, no grant to any runtime role, no patient text. Commands (SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pinned, owned by the owner of ocr.jobs): ocr.worker_page_allowance(uuid,uuid), ocr.record_worker_pages(uuid,uuid,integer,text) and ocr.pause_worker_job_for_allowance(uuid,uuid,text) for hid_ocr_worker (fail_worker_job's actor and claim checks; recording idempotent per job, larger count kept, audit ocr.worker.pages_recorded with pages only; worker_page_allowance answers paused false for a job whose pages are already recorded, so a retry is never parked by its own pages; the pause answers NULL and changes nothing unless pages_used >= pages_limit and the job's pages are not yet recorded (a limit raised since the read, or a retry), else processing -> failed -> queued with attempt_count - 1, last_error_code OCR_PAGE_ALLOWANCE_USED_UP, next_attempt_at = 00:00 Africa/Lagos on resets_on, audit ocr.worker.paused_for_allowance); ocr.facility_page_allowance(uuid) for hid_ocr_runtime (inherited by hid_ocr_api_runtime) and hid_identity_runtime (staff of that facility holding ocr.job.read via auth.membership_has_permission, or a platform session with platform.admin.access); ocr.set_facility_page_limit(uuid,integer,text) for hid_identity_runtime (platform session, platform.admin.access and an active platform_super_admin or platform_admin assignment, correlation id, healthcare-operations; upsert; platform audit row admin.ocr.page-limit.set that 0064's rules accept; above use it makes the facility's parked queued jobs due now). Default 500 pages per facility per month. runtime-grants.sql gains a 0110 block with exactly the grants the migration makes (USAGE on schema ocr to hid_ocr_worker, hid_ocr_runtime, hid_identity_runtime; the EXECUTE grants above; revokes from PUBLIC). PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only; 55000 or 42501, nothing applied): ocr.jobs, identity.facilities, auth.accounts, audit.events present; none of 0110's objects; md5 of ocr.validate_job_write, ocr.fail_worker_job, ocr.claim_worker_job (0014+0015 body or the rds-compat 0015 body), ocr.record_job_event, the six platform session helpers, auth.account_id_for_subject, auth.account_has_active_role, auth.account_has_platform_permission, auth.membership_has_permission, identity.has_active_membership, audit.authorize_platform_event; the trigger function's attributes; the two ocr.jobs triggers; 0064's three audit constraints and authority trigger; the four runtime roles where they exist (not superuser, not BYPASSRLS; on a fresh database the role bootstrap creates them after the migrations, so the grants are made only to roles that exist, as 0082 and 0097) and hid_ocr_api_runtime inheriting hid_ocr_runtime when both exist; the permissions and roles read; one owner for ocr.jobs and the worker commands, which may create in schema ocr; the applier is it or a member that inherits it and may SET ROLE to it. LOCKS (pg_locks before commit): beyond ACCESS SHARE only the new tables, the session's temporary objects and SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on identity.facilities (foreign keys); behind ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on ocr.jobs or identity.facilities the runner stopped after its 5 s lock_timeout with nothing applied; behind ROW EXCLUSIVE on ocr.jobs, auth.accounts and audit.events it applied in 0.2 s; apply about 40 ms. PROVED on throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 with pgvector: fresh install 0001-0103 and 0110 on an empty cluster with no runtime roles, migrations before the role bootstrap as run-container-database-acceptance.sh runs them (105 files; dry run rolled back, 0 pending after, role bootstrap and verification pass); upgrade of a bootstrapped 0103 database by the runner (plan 1 pending, dry run rolled back, apply, 0 pending, the file again answers '0110: already applied'); runtime privileges after the migration equal those after a role bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql and those of the fresh install, and differ from 0103's only by the grants above; all 78 database suites pass on both (77 existing and the new one); the new suite fails on 0103. services/ehr-api/scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs passed with a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator (MIGRATION_TARGET=rds; migration grants match runtime-grants.sql, 185 row-security settings unchanged). A NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS owner and a member login of it each apply 0110 (objects owned by the owner) and the new suite passes on both in its non-bypass mode (71 cases; worker commands answer 55000 as every OCR worker command does there). Negative copies stop with nothing applied (12 of 12, and a stranger login is refused 42501). Mutants: 20 of 20 killed. SUITE: services/ehr-api/test/database/ocr-page-allowance.integration.sql, 85 cases with a bypassing owner: security properties and grants, no table privilege for any runtime role; worker reads (default 500, Lagos month, resets_on), NULL or wrong token, another worker's job and a non-worker subject refused; recording idempotent (replay and smaller count write nothing, larger kept), bad counts refused, last month not counted; pause under the limit answers NULL and changes nothing; a retry whose 12 recorded pages are counted reads paused false at 500 of 500 and its pause answers NULL; at 500 of 500 the pause parks the job until 00:00 Lagos on resets_on with attempt 2 -> 1 and 1 -> 0, job events and audit, the claim skips it; staff read allowed for ocr.job.read at the facility and refused for another facility, another account's or an inactive membership, no membership and a pharmacist; platform read for super and support admins, refused without platform.admin.access; limit refused for a support admin, a non-admin, a facility session, no correlation id, another purpose and bad input; a limit below use resumes nothing; a raise above use resumes exactly the parked jobs with attempts kept and the claim then takes the job as attempt 2 of 3; the new trigger transition refuses other queued jobs, a later time and any other column.
